---
name: Bug report
about: Something doesn't work, or Google changed AI Studio or Flow and aistudio broke
---

**What you ran** (the `aistudio` command; leave out anything private)

**What happened** (the error or result)

**What the AI Studio or Flow page shows**, if it looks like a Google change (run the command
again with `--visible` to watch)

**Versions**: `aistudio --version`, Python version, Chrome version, macOS or Linux version

`-vv` output helps, but read it first and remove anything private. Please don't paste
cookies, API keys or anything from `~/.aistudio/`. Security problems go to private reporting,
see SECURITY.md.
